caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain and ESE Swell Impact Martinique Today
caribbean.paragraph: Martinique (Fort-de-France) is experiencing easterly winds to 12 kt, seas around 2.4 ft with a dominant 7 s ESE swell, and 100% rain probability at the port, and I am monitoring persistent rain that will reduce visibility and complicate small-boat operations. Roatan in the western Caribbean is the runner-up with winds to 20 kt, and I advise mariners to monitor conditions offshore for choppy periods near exposed shores.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Facing 23 kt Winds and 7 ft Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing northerly winds near 23 kt with seas to 7.0 ft and a 7 s northerly swell, with less than 10% rain probability. I advise caution for small craft around Mykonos where winds and seas are near Small Craft Advisory thresholds, while Venice remains light with winds around 10 kt.
